description: Stock management web app for Macroads. Replaces a hand-filled Excel workbook with yard-floor data entry, a live dashboard, and Excel as an export. Built as a Harness Engineering exercise: repo-as-system, leader/explorer/implementer/reviewer separation, spec-driven development.

features.name: repo_harness
features.title: Repository harness and spec foundation
features.description: Turn the directory into a system agents can work in: navigation map, docs, checkpoints, subagent definitions, progress log, verification entry point, and the two foundational specs.
acceptance: AC-1: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `CHECKPOINTS.md` exist at the repository root.

AC-3: `specs/` separates reference documents from feature specs: `specs/product-brief.md` and `specs/domain-model.md` carry no number, and feature specs live at `specs/features/NNN-<name>.md` where `NNN` is the feature id. `domain-model.md` documents the workbook layout, the normalisation rules, the period model, the roles and money boundary, and the target schema.

AC-4: `.claude/agents/` contains `leader.md`, `explorer.md`, `spec-writer.md`, `implementer.md` and `reviewer.md`, each with valid YAML frontmatter, and each one's declared `tools:` list permits the work its body instructs it to do.
AC-5: `progress/current.md` and `progress/history.md` exist, and this feature's implementation report exists at `progress/impl_repo_harness.md`.
AC-6: `init.ps1` and `init.sh` both run to completion and print `[OK] Environment ready` with no application code present, and both exit `0`.

AC-7: `init` verifies harness integrity: required files present; agent frontmatter valid; `feature_list.json` parses; every `status` and `spec_status` valid; at most one feature `in_progress`; every `spec_file` with `spec_status` other than `missing` exists on disk; **every `spec_file` matches `specs/features/NNN-<name>.md` for its own id and name**; no feature is `done` without an approved spec and a non-empty `acceptance` array.
AC-8: The repository is a git repository with a commit history, and `.gitignore` covers `node_modules`, `.env` and build output.
AC-9: Nothing under `Samples/` has been modified.
AC-10: Every question in `specs/domain-model.md` that blocks a feature before M7 is answered, and every remaining open question is referenced by the feature it blocks.

AC-11: The harness documents do not contradict each other. Specifically: no file states a money precision other than `Decimal(18,8)`; no file refers to the removed `COUNTER` or `MANAGER` roles; and no file refers to a feature name, spec filename or question id that does not exist.

features.name: app_scaffold
features.title: Next.js application scaffold
features.description: Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind, Prisma against a Neon Postgres dev branch, Vitest and Playwright wired up, all invoked from init. No Docker.

features.name: auth_and_roles
features.title: Accounts and role-based access
features.description: Auth.js credentials provider, User model, YARD_STAFF and ADMIN roles, route protection, role-shaped responses per specs/domain-model.md Part 6, seeded first admin.

features.name: domain_schema
features.title: Domain schema and first migration
features.description: Prisma schema per specs/domain-model.md Part 3: Location, Supplier, ItemType, Item, ItemPrice, ItemLocation, StockCount (keyed by location and period, with signature fields), StockCountLine (nullable quantity). Money is Decimal(18,8). Plus the migration and model-level tests.

features.name: seed_from_workbook
features.title: Seed the item master from the source workbook
features.description: Idempotent importer reading the Dublin and Clonmel sheets into Suppliers, ItemTypes, Items, ItemPrices and ItemLocation, applying the normalisation rules in specs/domain-model.md Part 2. Historical counts, the Summary sheet and the Trucks sheet are NOT imported. Emits an import report naming every item flagged needsReview.

features.name: item_master_ui
features.title: Item master administration
features.description: CRUD for items, suppliers and types; description required; versioned price lists; per-yard assignment and sheet ordering.

features.name: entry_start
features.title: Start a stock entry
features.description: Calendar view of existing counts, then confirm yard and date of entry. Period defaults from the date (day <= 5 closes the previous month) and is overridable. One count per yard per month. Pre-populated with that yard's active items in sheet order, quantities null. No business-day rule.

features.name: stock_entry_ui
features.title: Stock entry screen
features.description: Phone-first quantity entry with autosave. Distinguishes not-counted from counted-as-zero. Three filter categories (Supplier, Type, Unit) with multi-select within a category and AND across categories. YARD_STAFF sees no line values, no running total and no 'no price' tag.

features.name: entry_submit
features.title: Sign, submit and approve
features.description: Drawn signature stored as SVG path data, required before SUBMITTED. Submission blocked while any line is uncounted. Price snapshot written on submit. ADMIN approves; approved counts are immutable and reopening clears the signature.

features.name: stock_takes_history
features.title: Stock takes history
features.description: Calendar of historical counts with a Dublin / Clonmel / Both selector and previous/next-count jumps. Read-only detail: item, quantity, unit. Money-free for BOTH roles. Phone-first.

features.name: analysis
features.title: Analysis
features.description: ADMIN only, and the only place monetary figures appear: per-yard values, total stock, period completeness, month-on-month and year-on-year joined on period, trend chart, breakdown by type and supplier. Desktop grid, stacks on phone.

features.name: deploy
features.title: Production deployment
features.description: Neon Postgres plus Vercel, environment configuration, migrate deploy in the pipeline, documented backup and restore.

features.name: export_workbook
features.title: Excel export: full workbook
features.description: One .xlsx with Summary, Dublin and Clonmel sheets in the sample's shape, generated clean so no #REF!, no hardcoded value cells and no off-by-one YoY can occur. Held items only by default. Signature and signer printed on each yard sheet. Absorbs the former #13.

features.name: export_blank_count_sheet
features.title: Printable blank count sheet
features.description: A printable blank sheet listing all assigned items for a yard, as a paper fallback when the yard has no signal.

features.name: item_housekeeping
features.title: Dormant and incomplete item housekeeping
features.description: Items at zero across three or more consecutive counted periods are flagged for one-click archive by an ADMIN. Nothing is auto-archived; archiving never alters historical lines. The same screen lists items flagged needsReview, or missing unit or price.

features.name: trucks_schema_seed
features.title: Trucks and yard-bulk schema
features.description: Vehicle, BoilerReading, BagReading and YardBulkReading models, plus seeding of the truck registrations and role labels for BOTH yards - Dublin has its own trucks 09D, 10D and 141D at Dublin!AM94:AS96.
features.blocked_by_question: Q8 in specs/domain-model.md - a full boiler is 200kg on Dublin and 250kg on Clonmel; which is right?

features.name: trucks_entry_ui
features.title: Truck and yard-bulk entry
features.description: Boiler percent-full and bag counts per truck, yard bulk bags, with kilogram rollups per material.
features.blocked_by_question: Q7 in specs/domain-model.md - do truck materials roll into the yard total?

features.name: export_trucks_sheet
features.title: Excel export: trucks and yard sheet
features.description: Trucks and yard sheet export, reproducing the boiler, bag and yard-bulk blocks.
